title: Offence of money laundering
verbatim_text: A person shall be guilty of the offence of money laundering if the person: (a) acquires, converts, possesses, uses or transfers property, knowing or having reason to believe that such property is proceeds of crime; (b) conceals or disguises the true nature, origin, location, disposition, movement or ownership of property, knowing or having reason to believe that such property is proceeds of crime; (c) holds or possesses on behalf of any other person any property knowing or having reason to believe that such property is proceeds of crime.

title: Punishment for money laundering
verbatim_text: Whoever commits the offence of money laundering shall be punishable with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than one year but may extend to ten years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to twenty-five million rupees and shall also be liable to forfeiture of property involved in money laundering.

title: Attachment of property involved in money laundering
verbatim_text: (1) An investigating officer may, with the prior permission of the Court, attach any property involved in money laundering for a period not exceeding one hundred and eighty days.
